description: This file defines the Transport class used in the Bloodhound suggestion engine of typeahead.js. It manages AJAX requests, including request limiting, caching, and cancellation.

classes.name: Transport
classes.description: Class managing AJAX transport requests with caching, request limiting, and cancellation.

methods.name: setMaxPendingRequests
methods.description: Set maximum number of concurrent pending requests.

methods.name: resetCache
methods.description: Reset the shared cache used by Transport.
